title: Titanium PCB Edge Grip
function: High-density board edge grip for PCB plating
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for this plating rack application prioritizing formability and corrosion resistance over strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, its natural TiO2 passivation provides immunity to pitting in chlorides up to 260C. This rationale is driven by high-density board edge grip for pcb plating and specific design requirements.
process: CNC machining CP Ti for plating rack geometry
TIG welding Ti filler with Class 6g gauge
Pickling and passivation with Class 6g gauge
Continuity test <1 mOhm with Class 6g gauge
surfaceTreatment: Platinum cladding 2.5um minimum via electrodeposition for stable catalytic surface in electrochemical cells
commonFailures: Uneven coating from current density variation - corrected by auxiliary anode 50mm from cathode

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium PCB Edge Grip suitable for High-density board edge grip for PCB plating?
faq.a: Titanium PCB Edge Grip uses Grade 2 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address plating rack operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium PCB Edge Grip?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium PCB Edge Grip require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. plating rack components receive Platinum cladding 2.5um minimum via electrodeposition for stable catalytic surface in electrochemical cells. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the service environment.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium PCB Edge Grip shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements; (4) Surface roughness certification on critical features. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Edge grip / Board holder plating rack components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
